CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID ?? deriveLocalSessionId(host,root,ppid)，带 sessionSource) + owner-lease.json schema + acquire/refresh/release/takeOverOwnerLease + isLeaseStale(30min) + formatNonOwnerError。core/command-policy.ts: CommandPolicy 加 ownershipClass 5 类，全 94 命令分类。cli-engine.ts: run() 单一 choke-point enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate——非 owner 的 storyScopedMutating/dangerousMutating 命令 fail-closed 拒绝，readOnly 永不拦，reviewerWrite 窄豁免。handlers/session.ts: session_brief ownership 渲染 + B-META shared audit block。core/story-owner-lease-doctor.ts (新建): koala doctor stale-lease 扫描。tasks/command-ownership-contract.ts + story-owner-lease-smoke.ts: 契约 + smoke 测试。CLAUDE.md「多 session 写协调」段 + session-ownership-and-write-leases.md + story-lifecycle.md 同步。
usage: 多 session 并行开发时自动生效，无需手动调用：第一条 story-scoped mutating 命令为该 story acquire owner lease，后续 owner 命令刷新 heartbeat。非 owner session 跑 storyScopedMutating 命令被拒并提示 owner。`koala session_brief` 显示 ownership 块。owner 离线 30 分钟后 lease 判 stale，可 `koala <cmd> --takeover` 接管 stale lease；活跃 lease 需 `koala <cmd> --forceTakeover`（人工 override）。`koala doctor` 报告 stale story owner lease。可选 KOALA_SESSION_ID 环境变量作为 adapter/server 注入入口。
expectedOutcome: 非 owner session 跑 story-scoped mutating 命令时看到 fail-closed 错误：哪个 story 被 own、owner sessionId/cwd/last-heartbeat age、lease 是否 stale、允许的下一步动作；read-only 命令照常返回；koala session_brief 一屏显示 owner session/cwd/heartbeat age/stale|active/当前是否 owner/推荐动作。stale lease 可 --takeover、活跃 lease 需 --forceTakeover。
actualTranscript: 7 步真机测试（worktree 构建的 dist/cli.js）：(1) owner-lease.json 存在 owner=claude-code-env session；(2) owner 跑 verification_evidence_refresh_stale → exit 0 放行，heartbeatAt 推进；(3) 非 owner (KOALA_SESSION_ID=koala-foreign-B) 跑同命令 → exit 1 fail-closed，错误含 storyId/owner sessionId/heartbeat 25s ago/owner cwd/ACTIVE/下一步；(4) 非 owner checklist_get (read-only) → exit 0 放行；(5) 非 owner session_brief → 渲染 '## Story ownership (active)'，含 owner session [claude-code-env]/cwd/heartbeat 40s ago/this session NOT owner/recommended read-only only；(6) 非 owner --takeover 活跃 lease → exit 1 拒绝，提示需 --forceTakeover；(7) 非 owner --forceTakeover → exit 0 夺锁，owner-lease.json 转 koala-foreign-B，activity.jsonl 写 story-owner-lease-takeover event (kind forceTakeover, fromWasStale false)。完整记录见 .koala/story/actives/B-c55d/evidence/transcript-diff.md。
outcomeDiff: 无差异——7 步实际行为与 PLAN outcome 逐条一致。机械背书：koala validate --story=B-c55d 全绿 ALL PASS，verification intent 26/26 covered；story-owner-lease-smoke (cases 1-25) + command-ownership-contract (94 命令) 套件全 PASS。
limitations: 本地 session 协调，非强身份安全——sessionId 是本地流程协调 ID，不是 cryptographic identity，无 public/private key、无 server authority、无 reviewer attestation，不防伪。process.ppid 仅作最后 fallback（普通 terminal/CI 等 shell 持久环境）；Claude Code 环境靠 CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID 锚定。reviewer identity / attestation、跨 clone 锁不在本 story scope，由后续 story 跟进。
pitfalls: (1) process.ppid 实测在 Claude Code 环境不稳定——每次 Bash tool 调用是 新 shell 新 ppid，ppid 锚定会让 agent 第 2 条 storyScopedMutating 命令被 自己上一条的 lease 当 foreign 拒绝；改用 CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID 作 priority-2 锚点修复（PLAN 中途用户裁定）。(2) 全局 koala 是 main 构建、不含 gate；真机测 gate 必须用 worktree 构建的 packages/main/dist/cli.js。(3) owner-lease gate 与 phase gate 叠加：checklist_update 在 TEST 阶段先 被 phase gate 拦，真机测 owner-lease 拒绝要用 TEST 阶段合法的 storyScopedMutating 命令（如 verification_evidence_refresh_stale）。(4) owner gate 必须在 cli-engine.ts run() 单一 choke-point 判，不能散进 各 handler——B-META finding/validate --story/delivery_check_set 的边界 例外都在 resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass 一处解决。(5) dev_start/dev_finish/dev_merge/story_sync_main/story_migrate_storage 是 registry handler 但不在 MAIN_TOOLS、CLI 不可达，contract test 以 MAIN_TOOLS 为 权威 registry。
